answer: Canary tagging: each epoch every agent ID gets a private task hiding a unique token, like an ivory chip set in one pour of mortar. Tokens pass through a prism of 3 forms (a word, a number, a phrasing quirk), so filters can't strip them all. If an ID's token surfaces in another ID's output, shared context is the bridge that links them: both split one reward and lose a 25-token bond. Clones must run fully isolated contexts; at an assumed $4/month per sandbox, 200 fakes cost $800/month, linear per clone.
